accepted.quote: it is necessary to update antiquated statutory constraints that limit participation in the SBIC program.
accepted.rationale: The legislator states that updating statutory constraints is necessary to allow long-horizon investment in critical technologies through the SBIC program.

accepted.quote: it is important to provide utilization of ``bonus'' leverage upfront at the time of licensing, rather than a licensee requesting additional leverage midway through the investment period.
accepted.rationale: The legislator supports providing bonus leverage at licensing to drive additional SBIC investment to small manufacturers and rural and underserved communities.
